meta.title: Products
meta.description: Kesla truck and stationary cranes, logging equipment and tractor equipment. Pick your base machine to see the cranes, harvester heads, loaders, trailers and grapples that fit it.

cranes.intro: Truck-mounted and industrial cranes, known earlier as PEKU and FORESTERI. For short and long wood, chip processing, industrial use and recycling.
cranes.imageAlt: KESLA timber crane loading logs onto a truck at sunset

logging.imageAlt: KESLA 19RH III twinAX harvester head on an excavator in a pine forest

tractor.imageAlt: Tractor with a KESLA 144ND trailer and 316T loader carrying logs

timber.name: Timber cranes
timber.intro: Mostly truck-mounted, for handling timber. Straight-boom and Z-boom models.
timber.imageAlt: KESLA timber crane with a proG grapple on a truck in winter

city.name: City cranes
city.intro: For recycling, material handling and building sites. All City cranes have KESLA proSTABILITY.
city.imageAlt: KESLA City crane on a truck in a city street at night

g3.name: Grapples III
g3.intro: The largest KESLA grapples, for truck and industrial cranes. proG models are for timber, proGE models for energy wood.

heads.name: Harvester heads
heads.intro: Roller and stroke harvester heads for forest machines and excavators, including excavator harvester packages.
heads.imageAlt: KESLA 20RH harvester head cutting a log in a snowy forest

fmc.name: Forest machine cranes
fmc.imageAlt: KESLA 13105H crane with a harvester head on a forest machine

g2.name: Grapples II
g2.intro: proG timber grapples for forest machine cranes. They also fit loaders and cranes of other brands.

loaders.name: Loaders
loaders.intro: Tractor loaders built on the same solutions as Kesla's truck and forest machine cranes.
loaders.imageAlt: KESLA 305T loader on a forest trailer lifting logs behind a tractor

trailers.name: Trailers
trailers.imageAlt: KESLA 144ND timber trailer with a loader behind a tractor, loaded with logs

g1.name: Grapples I
g1.intro: proG grapples for tractor loaders, from 0.18 m² timber grapples to energy wood grapples, plus the KESLA 19GX felling head.
